Both responses give the correct answer, Friday 28 February 2025, and both stay under the 120-word limit. The weekday reasoning is the same in each: 365 days is 52 weeks plus 1 day, so Thursday moves to Friday.

Response A is more concise and clearer. Response B says the same thing in more words, which adds no real value. That small edge in concision is the only difference, so I give it to A.
